problem.title: Maximum White Tiles Covered by a Carpet
problem.problemStatement: Given intervals representing white tiles on a number line and the length of a carpet, determine the maximum number of white tiles that can be covered by placing the carpet optimally.
problem.input: • First line contains N and CarpetLength. • Next N lines each contain the start and end of an interval.
problem.output: • Print the maximum number of covered white tiles.
